kjv: wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up
mine: wineskins that were worn out, split, and patched up
note: No'dot are leather skins, which split and are patched; "bottles" now suggests glass.
Niqqudim (also v.12) means crumbs or crumbly bits (possibly "spotted"); "mouldy" is one guess, "crumbled" fits dry bread better.

kjv: Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood
mine: Let them live. So they became woodcutters
note: Vayyihyu is a narrative "and they became", reporting the outcome; KJV folds it into the leaders' speech as a command.
